message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, grouped by region and noted for their passenger traffic, connectivity, and importance to the national aviation network:

| Airport | City | State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|------|-------|-----------|------------------|
| **Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL)** | Atlanta | Georgia | ATL | Largest passenger hub in the world; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| **Los Angeles International Airport (LAX)** | Los Angeles | California | LAX | Major gateway to Asia, Oceania, and Latin America; busiest west coast airport. |
| **Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD)** | Chicago | Illinois | ORD | One of the busiest airports in the world; major hub for United Airlines and American Airlines. |
| **Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW)** | Dallas/Fort Worth | Texas | DFW | Largest airport in the U.S. by land area; major hub for American Airlines. |
| **Denver International Airport (DEN)** | Denver | Colorado | DEN | Largest airport in the U.S. by land area; major hub for United Airlines and Southwest Airlines. |
| **John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK)** | New York City | New York | JFK | Major gateway to Europe and the Caribbean; hub for American Airlines and Delta. |
| **San Francisco International Airport (SFO)** | San Francisco | California | SFO | Major hub for United Airlines; key gateway to Asia and the Pacific Rim. |
| **Seattle–Tacoma International Airport (SEA)** | Seattle | Washington | SEA | Major hub for Alaska Airlines; growing hub for Delta and United. |
| **Miami International Airport (MIA)** | Miami | Florida | MIA | Major hub for American Airlines; key gateway to Latin America and the Caribbean. |
| **Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport (PHX)** | Phoenix | Arizona | PHX | Major hub for American Airlines; one of the busiest airports in the Southwest. |
| **Orlando International Airport (MCO)** | Orlando | Florida | MCO | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; busiest airport in Florida. |
| **George Bush Intercontinental Airport (IAH)** | Houston | Texas | IAH | Major hub for United Airlines; one of the busiest airports in Texas. |
| **Philadelphia International Airport (PHL)** | Philadelphia | Pennsylvania | PHL | Major hub for American Airlines; key gateway to the Northeast. |
| **Detroit Metropolitan Wayne County Airport (DTW)** | Detroit | Michigan | DTW | Major hub for Delta Air Lines; one of the busiest airports in the Midwest. |
| **Boston Logan International Airport (BOS)** | Boston | Massachusetts | BOS | Major hub for JetBlue and Delta; key gateway to New England. |
| **Washington Dulles International Airport (IAD)** | Washington, D.C. | Virginia | IAD | Major hub for United Airlines; key gateway to the Mid-Atlantic. |
| **San Diego International Airport (SAN)** | San Diego | California | SAN | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; growing hub for United. |
| **Portland International Airport (PDX)** | Portland | Oregon | PDX | Major hub for Alaska Airlines; key gateway to the Pacific Northwest. |
| **Las Vegas McCarran International Airport (LAS)** | Las Vegas | Nevada | LAS | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; busiest airport in Nevada. |
| **Charlotte Douglas International Airport (CLT)** | Charlotte | North Carolina | CLT | Major hub for American Airlines; key gateway to the Southeast. |
| **St. Louis Lambert International Airport (STL)** | St. Louis | Missouri | STL | Major hub for Southwest Airlines; key gateway to the Midwest. |

These airports are among the busiest in terms of passenger traffic, flight operations, and connectivity, and they serve as major hubs for the largest U.S. airlines.
